translation:
If we all work together, we'll find the
"man-eating classroom” in no time.
Come on, let's go!
Wh-whaa?!
Um, p-please don't push me so much.
It's only 'cause you're moving like a corpse!

Come on, let's get on with it already—hurry
up!
Ahahaha! Go, go!

Good grief… Haruhi's even more energetic
than usual.

Then again, it's difficult to imagine Miss
Suzumiya in low spirits, isn't it?

Really? I feel like we've seen that countless
times already though.

Is that so? At the very least, I've never seen
it.

In that case, she probably seems that way
because she's around you.
Koizumi… What's that supposed to mean?
I meant exactly what I said.

To me, as long as Miss Suzumiya is always
enjoying herself…
I feel at ease.

I understand exactly what Koizumi is trying
to say.

The "Celestials” that appear as Haruhi builds
up stress…

Koizumi and the "Agency” do everything they
can to stop them from rampaging about.

So, what would happen if Haruhi actually
encountered unnatural phenomena?

Wouldn't we end up right back where we
started?

Indeed. I hope you can cooperate with us in
that respect.
Cooperate, huh… Say, Nagato…

What's going on with the man-eating
classroom now?

The singularities are slowly being repaired,
but not yet to the extent of it resurfacing.
However, it is only a matter of time.

Soon the singularities will interfere with each
other, and the space will shift out of phase.
…Where is it located?

Floor three of the main building, at the end of
the hall.

I see. If it's past classroom 1-9, the
man-eating classroom must be 1-10.

…Seems like it'd be disastrous to let Haruhi go
there right now.
For now, let's buy ourselves some time.
Agreed.
Hey, Haruhi!

What is it, Kyon? Aren't you acting cocky for
someone who's always late?

We're going to investigate the first-year
classrooms, right?

It wouldn't be very efficient for us to do it in
a single group.
How about we split into two teams?

First year is split over two floors, so we can
deal with this faster if we divide our efforts.

You're just planning to slack off either way,
right?
She has zero faith in me.
I'll go together with him.

Mhm. I suppose if you're with Koizumi, I don't
have to worry as much about you slacking.

Very well, then let's split into a girl team and a
boy team.

Then we—the boy team—shall go investigate
the third floor.

Miss Suzumiya's girl team can search on the
second floor.
I'm in the girl team?
Obviously.
Don't cause any trouble for Asahina, got it?
You too!
…She really can't keep her mouth shut.

Though thanks to Koizumi's artful
communication, Haruhi's been convinced.

He even designated where each of us is
going—credit where credit's due.

Then, it's a race to see who can finish their
investigation first!

Speed shouldn't really be a virtue in this
situation though… Good grief.

Even though we told her we're going to
investigate…

We already know what's going on, so there's
really nothing to look into.

I'm just glad we have a method to prevent
Miss Suzumiya from getting too close.
That's for sure…

As I move down the hallway, I start to feel a
premonition.

If I get mixed up with alternate space once
again, then who's going to save me this time?

There's a non-zero chance that help won't
come for me, right?
…Can't we use that to our advantage?
What do you mean, "that”?
The classroom's plate.

There's a protruding nameplate with "1-6”
written on it, is there not?
Ah, that? But how would we use it?

How about we take the plate off, and put up
class 7's in its place?
To what end?

Then class 8's plate where 7's should be,
class 9's plate in class 8's spot…

What about the one above class 9 then? Just
replace it with 6?

Not quite. We don't necessarily need to put
anything in class 9's place, do we?
Because that will be class 1-10…
I see. So that's what he's thinking.

So basically, the plan is to shift the
classrooms across?
Wait, there's a huge oversight in this plan.
Let's hear it.
What about class 6? It'll just disappear?

It's an obvious fact that class 6 should be
here. Even Haruhi knows that much.

She'll see through it right away, and realize
that it's merely a childish prank.
But isn't that perfectly fine?

Or rather, it may be more apt to say that's
precisely the point.

Quit beating around the bush. Just tell me
what you're getting at here.
Alright, I'll be frank.

We'll have Miss Suzumiya believe it's a mere
childish prank.
Make Haruhi think it's a prank?

There are people who fell for such a ridiculous
joke after all…
…The computer society!

Precisely. The computer society fell for the
prank.

And we were swept up by the words of those
gullible victims…
What do you think?
…Would Haruhi really accept that?
Well, I can't say for sure.

But I think it's certainly more useful than
standing around and doing nothing.
I guess that's true… Okay, I'm in.

So I guess we should just get this 1-6 plate
off to start?

Indeed. And then we'll affix the class 7 plate
as a substitute.
Got it. Wait just a sec.

The plate is installed pretty high up.
…Can I reach it?
Think you can get it?
Well, I'm sure I can make it if I stretch.
Then, just as I tried to take off the plate…

Footsteps. As well as a loud voice coming from
the stairwell.

Hey, you two! How's it going over there?
We're done already!
She's early!
Let's be quick!

You say that, but if we get caught, this will all
be for nothing!

If we hurry, we should still be able to make it in
time. Quickly now!
Are we seriously going to make it…?
Hup!

I couldn't quite reach the plate even after I
stretched, but I managed it with a jump.
Only to lose my balance…
Uh, wha?!
Careful!

Thankfully, Koizumi somehow caught my shoul-
der, saving me from landing on my backside.
Sorry about that.

Not at all—for something so slight, think
nothing of it.

However, it does look like we've run out of time
to offset the other plates.
What should we do now? Give up?
…I don't think we have a choice.

In the end, we had to settle for just class 6's
plate being taken down.

For now, this could at least serve as an
indication of tampering.
I hope so…
What do we do with this plate then?
Allow me to look after it.

Saying so, Koizumi took the plate and stored
it inside his blazer.
Hopefully we can find a use for this.
Quite right… Let's pray this goes well.

No way. If Haruhi even catches a glimpse of
me grabbing the plate, it's all over.

Not only will the trick be exposed, but she
might get excited and go check it out herself.

Then beyond class 9… I'm worried she'll bump
into the alternate space.

…Understood. Let's abandon that plan for
now.

We'll have to come up with some other way to
divert her attention.

Yeah. I'll distract her by indulging in some of
her favorite topics.

So? Are you guys done investigating over
here?

Haruhi asked us, having just barreled up the
stairway two steps at a time.

Yeah, we just finished checking the other end
of the hall.

That's too bad. Here I was hoping to punish
you for lazing around.

In truth, we hadn't actually moved from where
we were already standing.

It would've been quite problematic for us if
she were aware of that fact.
So, did you find anything?
What does it look like?

There wasn't a single odd thing. Nothing more
than a regular hallway.

Right… Well, seems like we couldn't find
anything at all.
Quickly take it
Give up
